Hi Chris / Priya —

Thanks for the call — quick technical notes to clarify the numbers in Dylan’s readout and address the latency/throughput questions you raised: 

1) p95 behavior: the p95 spike you saw is consistent with small batch sizes and KV cache misses for 512-token seq. In a Dedicated setup with prefix caching enabled and a steady input stream, we typically see p95 reduce ~30–40% compared to on-demand runs.

2) Throughput: for the model variant you used, a single NVIDIA A40-equivalent instance in our Dedicated configuration (with 8k context optimizations) sustained ~220 reqs/min at 1k tokens avg before hitting 95th percentile targets. If you expect burst concurrency above that, we recommend the auto-scale config attached in the infra diagram.

3) Cold-starts & KV cache: cold-start latency is primarily impacted by kernel warm-up & attention compilation for new sequence lengths. If you pin model variants and warm the cache with short prep loads, cold-starts drop from ~300ms to under ~80ms for subsequent requests.

I’ve attached a short note (see section 2 of the readout) that lists the knobs we can tune during the bench: model quantization profile, batch size target, and cache TTL. Happy to run these during the POC.

If it helps, I can run a short scripted replay of your sample trace during the bench so we can exercise realistic tail behavior — that usually highlights any queueing artifacts.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Priya / Chris —

Just bumping this thread in case the clarifications from Neha got buried — happy to answer the two points below in one line each: 

- Intermittent traffic: we can use a combination of short-lived warmers and a modest cache TTL to handle bursty patterns without requiring steady traffic; we’ll show the tradeoffs during the bench.
- Replay at 10x: yes — we can replay at higher concurrency for a short window. We usually throttle to avoid noisy-neighbor impacts, but a 10x synthetic burst for 5–10 minutes is fine in a dedicated bench.

If this still looks good, would you prefer Wed Jul 7 or Thu Jul 8 morning PT for the 2-hour bench slot? I can provision the environment and we’ll include a 1-hour post-bench readout.

Also — if BlueHorizon confirms priority this week, I can put together a small pilot credit (30% of the bench cost) to shorten the procurement path.

If you’re swamped, a one-line reply with preferred day/time is enough and we’ll take it from there.

Cheers,
Dylan
